1

SCMC™

(Smart Chemical Monitoring & Controller)

• Continuous water testing every 20 milliseconds.

• Automatically adds disinfectant and pH control as needed.

• Features Swiss-manufactured probes for accuracy and durability.

• Predicts chemical consumption for smarter inventory management.

• Sends real-time alarms and notifications for critical updates.

2

HoneyBee™

• Transforms your chemical dosing device into a smart, connected system.

• Enhances automation for precision and efficiency in chemical management.

3

RoboArm™

(Automated Water Titration Testing)

• Utilizes Taylor™ test kits with advanced Computer Vision technology.

• Tests Alkalinity, pH, Free/Combined/Total Chlorine, and Total Bromine.

• Eliminates human error and environmental interference.

4

KIOSK™

• Keeps the community informed with on-site updates.

• Enables instant feedback for better engagement.

• Operates touch-free for enhanced hygiene and convenience.

5

RoboGuard™

(Occupancy & Safety Monitoring)

• Alerts to prevent accidents like drowning.

• Tracks bather count and movement across water zones.

• Monitors ambient temperature, water clarity, and water level.

6

RemoraVR™

(Advanced Vacuum Release & Mechanical Fault Detection System)

• Automatically shuts down pumps during entrapment events.

• Operates remote strobe lights and alarm devices for alerts.

• Tracks backwash needs, pump prime loss, and return line blockages.

• Monitors the health of pumps and filters for proactive maintenance.

Virtuous Cycle of Commercial Pool Operations

At PoolPal™, we’re transforming the management of commercial swimming pools by integrating cutting-edge technology to enhance safety, operational efficiency, and sustainability. Our intuitive, connected platform provides pool operators with real-time insights and actionable recommendations, keeping them constantly informed and empowered.
With PoolPal’s advanced IoT sensors and AI-driven analytics, we predict maintenance requirements and potential equipment failures before they become problems, extending the lifespan of pool infrastructure. Our digital platform also ensures seamless engagement with the community, offering instant access to up-to-date pool conditions for swimmers and operators alike, delivering a flawless experience every time.
